name: debug
description: Diagnose bugs and performance regressions, reproduce failures, and fix root causes with regression tests and bundled browser, TDD, and merge-conflict workflows.

interface.longDescription: Bundle all nine Engineering Suite Debug workflows with their diagnosis loop template, testing examples, module-design references, and performance checklist. Uses host repository tools and project test commands; browser checks additionally require a separately configured Chrome DevTools MCP server, Chrome, and Node.js. Upstream attribution and MIT licenses are preserved; Arnold Stark maintains this marketplace packaging.
defaultPrompt: Use Debug to diagnose this regression and fix its root cause with a regression test.
Use Debug to find why this browser flow is failing.
Use Debug to measure and investigate this performance regression.
